wwox_observation: [DATO, Cheng 2020] Lithium (repeated pretreatment within an hour before the provoking injection) lowered the provoked-seizure stage in all three genotypes, including wild type at the floor (mean stage over minutes 1 to 60: +/+ 0.27 against 0.12, +/- 0.42 against 0.16, -/- 1.20 against 0.22; N 12 against 8, 12 against 12, 6 against 7; SCI exact values from the vector panel); the effect is proportionally larger in the knockout (82 against 54 percent), which the figure cannot show to exceed noise. The only GSK-3 measurement in a Wwox-null animal is one p-Ser9 blot (one lane per genotype and region; the ages of the legend and the Methods disagree).
mechanism_and_missing_bridge: A general property: in wild-type mice acute lithium raises the PTZ clonic threshold in several abstracts (one family also found acute lithium pro-convulsant and chronic threshold-raising), in rats the effect is very weak or absent, and lithium potentiates pilocarpine-type seizures several-fold; other GSK-3 inhibitors are anticonvulsant in several unrelated provoked models and worse or opposite in others. An effect in all genotypes is what a general property predicts. [INFERENZA from DATO at abstract level]
probe_or_qualified_compound: Lithium (named by the source). A second GSK-3 inhibitor of another class and a general anticonvulsant comparator that does not act on this kinase are the controls; no compound is proposed for any use.
action_cell_context: The same assay as INV-04, the same session and the same vehicle group per genotype; the lithium regimen is stated before data.
competing_alternative: L2 GSK-3-specific, knockout-enhanced; L3 a regimen artefact.
favourable_result: Lithium effect in all genotypes (interaction ratio between 0.7 and 1.43), the second GSK-3 inhibitor effective, the comparator effective: a general anticonvulsant effect of GSK-3 inhibition and of the comparator.
weakening_result: A knockout-larger effect reproduced by the second GSK-3 inhibitor and not by the comparator (L2).
next_decision: As INV-04: the provoked-assay pilot first; the genotype-by-treatment term pre-specified.

Cell-line data point both ways (WWOX knock-down raised GSK-3beta and Tau phosphorylation in one neuroblastoma line; WWOX overexpression lowered GSK-3beta-driven Tau phosphorylation in another); WWOX binds Dvl and restrains Wnt output in cancer lines (TRANSFER).
mechanism_and_missing_bridge: GSK-3-specific, knockout-enhanced: more active GSK-3 is INFERRED from a lower p-Ser9 (no kinase assay). Two readings predict opposite beta-catenin signs: a p-Ser9 fall lowers beta-catenin, Dvl release raises Wnt output; neither is measured in Wwox-null brain.
probe_or_qualified_compound: Lithium plus a second, chemically unrelated GSK-3 inhibitor with published selectivity and rodent brain exposure; a non-GSK-3 anticonvulsant comparator.
action_cell_context: Genotype-crossed assay as L1; optional add-on: p-Ser9, total GSK-3beta and a kinase or beta-catenin readout in tissue from the same animals.
competing_alternative: L1 and L3; lithium has other targets (inositol depletion; an inositol add-back arm is not GSK-3-free).
favourable_result: A knockout-larger lithium effect reproduced by the second GSK-3 inhibitor and not by the comparator, with a p-Ser9 or kinase change in the treated animals.
weakening_result: The second GSK-3 inhibitor does not reproduce it, or the comparator does (a general effect). wwox_observation: [IPOTESI, conditional] The development endpoints of the AAV9 comparator (survival to a fixed end age beyond day 17, weight series, one composite motor score at a fixed age, GFAP, myelination, brain size at about day 20) in a separate in vivo cohort for lithium, litter-blocked, with its own vehicle-only knockout group; no development datum exists for any non-gene agent; the sign of GSK-3 inhibition for myelination is divided.
mechanism_and_missing_bridge: Runs only after the provoked assay shows a lithium effect that is selective (interaction outside 0.7 to 1.43, reproduced by the second GSK-3 inhibitor and not by the comparator); if the interaction cannot be sized, the condition is the GSK-3 pharmacology in the knockout with the interaction as an exploratory interval; dropped if the effect is general.
probe_or_qualified_compound: Lithium and, if run, a second GSK-3 inhibitor; ethosuximide, the NMDAR pore blockers and vigabatrin do not qualify (reasons in the ADV-058 unit-2 text).
action_cell_context: Separate cohort dosed from the first days of life (the start age is the laboratory's); harms endpoints of its own (renal and thyroid readouts as the label lists).
competing_alternative: L1 (a general anticonvulsant effect gives no development rationale).
favourable_result: A development endpoint moved relative to vehicle knockouts.
weakening_result: Nothing moved, or an early floor (untreated knockouts die by about day 17).
next_decision: Prevention against rescue; durability; pup exposure; no overexpression endpoint for a drug.
